∀ {n : ℕ},
  0 < n →
    ∀ (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
      Monotone τ →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < τ i) →
          (∃ i, τ i ≠ ⊤) →
            ∀ (r : ENNReal),
              0 < r →
                r ≠ ⊤ →
                  ∃ j,
                    τ j ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ r ∧
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ r = (r + ↑(↑j + 1)) / ∑ i ≤ j, (τ i)⁻¹
